hook: 1.6 million pounds of thrust, and it was bolted to the ground.
narration: This rocket was making one point six million pounds of thrust while bolted down.
NASA fired all four engines on its Moon rocket's core stage in Mississippi.
Green means new hardware, [short pause] running together for the first time.
outcome: All four engines ran the full eight minutes and shut down safely.
title: Moon rocket fired while bolted down
description:
NASA fired all four RS-25 engines of its Space Launch System core stage at Stennis Space Center, Mississippi, on March 18, 2021, producing 1.6 million pounds of thrust in the final Green Run test.

Footage: NASA video, via the NASA Image and Video Library: https://images.nasa.gov/details/NHQ_2021_0318_Green%20Run%20Wrap
